test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-3) Official Paper (Held On: 17 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, BUT is written as DWV and LOW is written as NQY. How will CUP be written in that language?
solution:
The positional values of English alphabet is as follows : 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0feadec6334417d48300e8b565d1c1d9e73015cad02726ea6b55b6976b18ed05.png] 

The pattern followed here is :

 BUT is written as DWV 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bee9f203cd44371f8a695a908d3957cf3aa854b23ebe25fd46ac368fe64b1e27.png] 

 LOW is written as NQY

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7bc431d5bc753afe5e0cf9e80978b846ef310ce4ae08176761b45b23f3eb50ac.png] 

Similarly, CUP is written as:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c57e6b4bea3e2e33626880346fbaeb584481964cc7ecb5c49523fe60795f77ca.png] 

Hence,** EWR **is the** **correct answer.
